Municipal Police.
C. I. D.
No. 4060
Date. 29/8/21
Central Station.
August 28, 1921.
REPORT ON Leaflet advocating the abolition of extraterritoriality.
Made by D.I. Sullivan. Forwarded by Director of Criminal Intelligence.
Sir,
A specimen of the attached leaflet was given to Chief
Detective Inspector Traissac of the French Police on August
27. Chief Inspector Traissac states that it was forwarded
to the French Consul General so that steps could be taken
in Peking.
Two more samples have been obtained by the French
Police of which the Police have proof that they came to
Shanghai from Peking by post, and the French Police are of
opinion that no good would come of taking steps against
the local office of the National Organizations Union.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
J. Sullivan.
D.I.
D.C.I.

日期：21年8月29日
中央捕房。
1921年8月28日。
关于倡导废除治外法权传单的报告。
由警司沙利文 (Sullivan) 呈报。经刑事侦缉处处长转发。
敬启者：
附件传单样本一份已于8月27日交给法国警察局的特雷萨克 (Traissac) 总巡捕。特雷萨克总巡捕称，该样本已转交法国总领事，以便在北京采取行动。
法国警察局又获取了两份样本，并有证据证明这些样本是通过邮政从北京寄至上海的。法国警察局认为，对全国各界联合会上海办事处采取行动不会有什么好结果。
此致
敬礼
J. 沙利文 (J. Sullivan)。
警司 (D.I.)
刑事侦缉处处长 (D.C.I.)

The attached leaflet was obtained from the
National Organisations Union of China, 104 Seu Teh
Lee(樹德里 ), Rue Amiral Bayle, on August 25. There
is reason to believe that the leaflets emanate from
Peking. A Translation is as follows :-

"Telegram to the Provincial Assemblies, Chambers of
Commerce, educational associations and all public
organizations in all provinces and special districts.
Extraterritoriality meddles with our national
sovereignty and insults our nation. Despite the fact that
extraterritoriality should not exist among nations of
equal standing and that there are reasons supporting the
withdrawal of same, foreigners seized this right. While
their control over their own nationals already seems
unreasonable, it is more extraordinary that they, as
guests, deprived the hosts of their rights and also control
us, Chinese. Moreover, the Settlement in Shanghai is
contrary to treaty. Since the Court (Mixed Court?)
was established, we, Chinese, are treated cruelly.
We, Chinese citizens, have been ruled under the filthy
majesty of foreign races, like slaves of a ruined
nation, or dogs who missed their masters, our lives being
at random, money and property squeezed, customs demoralized,
human standard cruelly regarded, liberty confined, fame
damaged. In some cases they even acted in disobedience
of the law. Chinese lawyers are not allowed to practise
in the Court, criticism and comments are prohibited,
newspapers are forbidden to publish frank accounts,
Chinese merchants never have a voice in the local govern-
ment in which event justice is buried, and Chinese
defendants are not permitted to argue. Besides, they,
by all severe and cruel means collect taxes and rates,

附件传单于8月25日从位于白来尼蒙马浪路 (Rue Amiral Bayle) 树德里104号的“中华全国各界联合会” (National Organisations Union of China) 查获。有理由相信该传单发自北京。译文如下：-

“致各省及特别区之省议会、商会、教育会及所有公共团体的电报。
治外法权干涉我国主权，侮辱我国民族。尽管在地位平等的国家之间不应存在治外法权，且有理由支持撤销该权利，但外国人却攫取了这一权利。虽然他们对本国国民的管辖已显得不合理，但更离奇的是，他们作为客人，剥夺了主人的权利，还控制我们中国人。此外，上海租界违背条约。自从会审公廨 (Mixed Court?) 设立以来，我们中国人受到残酷对待。
我们中国公民，一直在外国种族的污秽威严统治之下，如同亡国之奴，或如失去主人的狗，生命随意被处置，钱财财产被榨取，风俗道德败坏，人格标准被残酷轻视，自由受限，名誉受损。在某些情况下，他们甚至违法行事。中国律师不准在法庭执业，批评和评论被禁止，报纸不准刊登直率报道，中国商人在地方政府中从未有发言权，致使正义被埋没，中国被告不被允许辩护。此外，他们通过各种严厉和残酷的手段征收税捐，

pages.en:
with their amounts increased year by year. This is
extremely cruel. The authorities concerned strike
passers-by with whips and disinter the bodies of the
dead. Innocent beggars are confined and not given any
food. Detectives and policemen are like wolves and
tigers, while detective sergeants and interpreters look
like wild beasts. These men always find fault with
others in the hope that the latter may be fined and
offended. There are all sorts of such secret actions
and you can never enumerate them. Such are the conse-
quences of extraterritoriality. We, the undersigned,
have lived in Shanghai for a considerable length of time,
and what we heard and saw are all true facts. As we
cannot endure any longer, we, sometime during the last
Autumn within the limits of this tiger-and-wolfe-like
scope, gathered together sympathetic people from all
provinces and secretly organized ourselves in a body.
We have subsequently forwarded a report and sent men to
Peking to petition the Government. The government has
promised to consider our petition and will negotiate
about this matter. We started with the aim of securing
a good result and have always been planning for same.
However, our ability is very little, and being in the
fear that we might fail to obtain a good and quick
result, and as your society love the nation, her sovereign
rights and sympathize with the sufferings of the people,
we specially send you this telegram informing you of the
whole thing and requesting that a delegate of your
society be sent here to Peking in order that a last
petition or a joint telegram be despatched to the govern-
ment requesting it to demand the abolition of extraterri-
torial rights. If your society agree with us, please
inform us of the name of your delegate and the date of
his arrival at Peking, so that we can extend our welcome.
pages.zh:
且数额逐年增加。这极其残酷。有关当局用鞭子抽打路人，挖掘死者尸体。无辜乞丐被拘禁且不给予任何食物。侦探和警察如狼似虎，而侦探巡长和翻译则形同野兽。这些人总是挑剔他人毛病，希望后者被罚款和冒犯。此类秘密行动种类繁多，不胜枚举。这就是治外法权的后果。我们署名者在上海生活了相当长的时间，所见所闻均为事实。由于我们无法再忍受，去年秋季，在这如虎狼般的范围内，我们聚集了来自各省的同情者，并秘密组织起来。
随后，我们提交了报告并派人前往北京向政府请愿。政府承诺考虑我们的请愿，并将就此事项进行谈判。我们开始的目标是争取良好的结果，并一直为此筹划。
然而，我们的能力非常有限，担心无法获得良好且迅速的结果，鉴于贵社爱国、尊重主权并同情民众疾苦，我们特此发送此电报，告知全部情况，并请贵社派遣代表前来北京，以便向政府发出最后请愿书或联合电报，要求政府主张废除治外法权。如贵社同意我方观点，请告知代表姓名及抵达北京日期，以便我们表示欢迎。

且数额逐年增加。这极其残酷。有关当局用鞭子抽打路人，挖掘死者尸体。无辜乞丐被拘禁且不给予任何食物。侦探和警察如狼似虎，而侦探巡长和翻译则形同野兽。这些人总是挑剔他人毛病，希望后者被罚款和冒犯。此类秘密行动种类繁多，不胜枚举。这就是治外法权的后果。我们署名者在上海生活了相当长的时间，上述所言均为事实。由于我们无法再忍受，去年秋季，在这如虎狼般的范围内聚会，我们聚集了来自各省的同情者，并秘密组织起来。
随后，我们提交了报告并派人前往北京向政府请愿。政府承诺考虑我们的请愿，并将就此事项进行谈判。其初衷是争取良好的结果，并一直为此努力。
然而，我们的能力非常有限，担心面对可能无法获得满意结果的局面，鉴于贵社爱国、尊重主权并同情民众疾苦，我们特此发送此信，告知全部情况，并希望贵社加入我们，以便向政府发出联合请愿书或联合电报，要求政府废除治外法权。如贵社同意我方观点，请告知代表姓名及抵达北京日期，以便我们安排欢迎。
